name: Fancy Tag
summary: Run into a awesome online experience with Fancy Tag, where you can team up with friends or challenge random players. You'll seek a variety of fun and unique game modes designed to keep you entertained. Utilizing the incredible locomotion system inspired by Gorilla Tag, you'll enjoy smooth, intuitive movement as you navigate through dynamic environments.
